title: Moving to New Orleans and the Irish Channel
summary: Braud says he came to New Orleans around 1911 and lived in the rough Irish Channel.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Is that Aubin moving down around there?
No. Abin. Abin. Yeah, well that's near Donisonville.
When did you move down here then?

Oh, I must have came to New Orleans around 1911. And I stayed in New Orleans. And I lived from New Orleans for Chicago. At that time, I was living on St. Mary's Street between Nunciation and Chippy Wall. Irish Channel, they called it. Yeah. Kind of rough neighborhood.
Yeah, I guess uptown, it was rough someplace.
Yeah. Well, it was strictly Irish neighborhood. They were pretty rough boys. Yeah.
